title: Don't End The Thread
style: emotional alt-rap synth ballad, 86 BPM, warm pad, close vocal, sparse trap drums, melodic rap verses, sung chorus, late-night confessional, honest delivery, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro - warm pad, close vocal, almost whispered]
don't end the thread tonight
don't end the thread tonight
the last thing you said is the last thing i read
and i'm not ready for that to be the last thing said

[Verse 1 - melodic rap, close mic]
i know you're tired and the day was long
i know my last reply came across all wrong
i was trying to be funny, i was trying to be light
and i landed in the place where the timing wasn't right

so the dots came up and the dots went away
and i watched them blink for the rest of the day
and i typed three drafts that i never sent
because i didn't know which version of sorry meant
the most

[Pre-Chorus - sparse trap kick enters]
so don't end the thread
don't end the thread
leave it open till the morning
leave it open till we're fed
and rested and able to mean what we said

[Chorus - sung, melodic, full pad]
don't end the thread tonight
don't end the thread tonight
fights end when somebody walks away
but threads end when somebody stops trying to say
so don't end the thread tonight
leave a little open, leave a little light

[Verse 2 - melodic rap, slightly more energy]
i know it's late and i know you're done
i know you've been carrying it since the day begun
i'm not asking you to fix it, i'm not asking you to write
i'm just asking you to leave the thread open tonight

because silence in a thread feels different than silence in a room
silence in a room is rest, silence in a thread is doom
and i don't want doom, i just want sleep
and a message in the morning that says i'm here, we're deep
but we're okay

[Pre-Chorus]
so don't end the thread
don't end the thread
leave it open till the morning
leave it open till we're fed
and rested and able to mean what we said

[Chorus]
don't end the thread tonight
don't end the thread tonight
fights end when somebody walks away
but threads end when somebody stops trying to say
so don't end the thread tonight
leave a little open, leave a little light

[Bridge - pad alone, close vocal, almost spoken]
the thread isn't the relationship.
the thread is the proof we're still in the relationship.
so even if you've got nothing to say,
say nothing on purpose, on the thread, where i can see it.
that's not silence. that's a held line.

[Final Chorus - bigger, harmonies, full pad]
don't end the thread tonight
don't end the thread tonight
fights end when somebody walks away
but threads end when somebody stops trying to say
so don't end the thread tonight
leave a little open, leave a little light
don't end the thread tonight
leave a little open, leave a little light

[Outro - whisper, pad fades]
i'll be here in the morning.
leave the thread open.
leave a little light.
